title: PAVE: A Harness for Geometrically Consistent Road Network Modeling with Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transportation models, whether they simulate traffic or support planning, are only as reliable as the road networks they run on, down to the lanes and turns at each intersection. Practitioners still take such a network from GIS files and supply its junction and movement data by hand, a task that recurs with each new base year and design alternative, or they generate it from open map data. OpenStreetMap's lane tags give the correct layout for only 13 of the 44 approaches we test; open map data are often incomplete or inaccurate. Satellite and street-level imagery, in contrast, cover all 44 and show their lanes as painted. Vision-language models (VLMs) can read such imagery, but asked directly they lose geometric consistency when the same lane must be matched across a satellite crop, street-level photos taken from different poses and an ID-labelled network. translated_title: PAVE：一种基于视觉语言模型、具有几何一致性的路网建模框架
translated_abstract: 交通运输模型——无论是用于交通模拟还是规划支持——其可靠性取决于所运行的道路网络，精确到每个交叉口的车道与转向。从业者目前仍需从GIS文件中获取路网，并手工录入其交叉口和流向数据，这项工作随着每个新的基准年份和设计方案而反复进行；或者他们从开放地图数据中生成这些信息。在我们测试的44个进口道中，OpenStreetMap的车道标签仅能为其中13个提供正确的布局；开放地图数据往往不完整或不准确。相比之下，卫星影像和街景影像覆盖了全部44个进口道，并以路面标线的形式呈现车道信息。视觉语言模型（VLM）能够读取这类影像，但如果直接使用，当同一条车道需要在卫星影像裁剪图、不同视角拍摄的街景照片以及带有ID标注的路网之间进行匹配时，模型会丧失几何一致性。因此，我们提出了PAVE（Perceive感知、Anchor锚定、Verify验证、Edit编辑），一个在其中……
tldr: 提出PAVE框架，通过感知、锚定、验证、编辑四个环节，利用视觉语言模型从卫星影像和街景影像中构建具有几何一致性的道路网络模型，克服了开放地图数据不完整、不准确以及VLM直接使用时几何一致性缺失的问题。
en_tdlr: PAVE is a harness that uses vision-language models through Perceive, Anchor, Verify, and Edit steps to build geometrically consistent road network models from satellite and street-level imagery, overcoming the incompleteness of open map data and the geometric inconsistency of directly applying VLMs.
